envelope.description: Stop the shared validate path asserting a flag it cannot know

body.title: Stop the shared validate path asserting a flag it cannot know
body.summary: Remove the unconditional `standalone: false` from runValidateSession's meta write (validate.ts:163) so mergeWithPrior's `...rec.meta` spread lets the prior value survive. With t8 the renderer no longer reads the flag, which makes this belt-and-braces BY DESIGN: the two halves fail independently, and leaving a shared code path writing a value it cannot determine is exactly how this defect returns wearing different clothes.
acceptanceChecks: The shared validate persist does NOT write `standalone` at all — asserted on the persisted json, not on an in-memory value
A standalone build driven through implement then validate keeps meta.standalone true and still renders '## Scope' and '## Triage rationale'
t1's TEST B (the forced meta.standalone false) is INVERTED in this same change — rewritten to assert the correct behaviour, not deleted and not skipped
MUTATION PROOF, run and recorded: restoring the unconditional `standalone: false` write turns the Scope-retention test RED
mergeWithPrior's createdAt preservation and approval stamps are untouched — a re-run still lands in the SAME folder and never un-completes a Story
